messages.subject: Debugging - Error Routing
parts:
Hello,

Im not sure how to see the stacktrace of errors in Shiny, when they come from the server.R file. They don't appear to get written to the console. I'd like to be able to do a step-through type debugging, but I can't seem to make this happen.

Best,

Zach

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: Debugging - Error Routing
parts:
I assume you placed a browser() at the place where you want to debug the code.

I found that if you do this within a renderPrint it doesn't work as renderPrint "hijacks" the output to the console and redirects it to the webpage and it will show everything once the R finishes running.

For a quick fix, just change your renderPrint to renderUI while debugging and change it back once you are done.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Debugging - Error Routing
parts: Sadly this isn't currently possible. Stack traces in R are not available if the error is caught; only if it escapes all the way to the toplevel is the stack trace even captured. We've made R core aware of this and there are sympathetic parties but at the moment we are kind of stuck in this situation.
